name: Driftline Instrument System
summary: A restrained, accessible interface system that makes portfolio movement, stalled work, and human decision points explicit for a fictional ocean-research organization.

principles.name: Make flow visible
principles.description: Movement and blockage appear before secondary metrics.

principles.name: Explain the prompt
principles.description: Every intervention shows its rule, evidence, age, owner, and clearing condition.

principles.name: Preserve human judgment
principles.description: The system routes attention while people decide, delegate, and support.

principles.name: Earn the density
principles.description: Compact information remains readable, structured, and resilient.
